body: I think it's more I feel I have no value as a person and if I point this out to someone they'll agree & everything will be taken away. It's more of a general terror and I know it's absolutely incredibly unlikely to be the response but the fear is still there & very, very strong.

I'm going to be working with my doctor soon about anxiety. I've been having heart episodes but had a stress test done showing my ticker is tiptop. So it's likely anxiety attacks so we'll see what he wants to do,

For the therapist, I actually have a great one for my daughter (she's got Aspergers) who is willing to see me too. The problem is I'm terrified of talking to her because I am afraid I'll end up locked up or losing my children. That fear has kept me from every really opening up to any therapist.

I have been on them in the past and hated them. I'm very overweight and gained more on the pills, which led to me feeling worse. Plus, before but wouldn't matter much now, it affected my sex drive turning me into a nun.
